reviewer.independence_basis: Separate Astra reviewer with no author conversation; inspected fixed source, goal, policy, manifest and artifact hashes, and rebuilt from git archive. No host operation.

code_candidate_evidence: Manifest commit and SHA-256 match; only the candidate manifest was added after the fixed source commit. Policy, binary, script, unit and tokens hashes match the fixed candidate.
An independent git archive rebuild with Go 1.25.5, linux/amd64, CGO disabled and -buildvcs=false -trimpath produced the same binary SHA-256. go version -m confirmed build settings.
Independent go test ./... passed all packages; installer bash -n passed. No Linux host start or browser E2E was performed by the reviewer.

The unit fixes 127.0.0.1:8787 and mock-worker. Startup rejects non-numeric-loopback bind and simultaneous mock/isolated mode. HTTP cannot change worker mode; mock processing invokes no model, GitHub or deployment.

Store.Open rejects filesystem root, final symlink and group/other-accessible state directory before creating the lock. Installer uses a new dedicated identity and 0700 state, rejects occupied resources, verifies hashes after protected staging and installation, and checks effective systemd settings before start.

Daily report is a one-per-JST-day local outbox record after provisional 20:00, without a configured sender. UI uses html/template escaping and same-origin CSS; no external asset or send path was added.

Changes since prior reviewed source cover intermediate Git symlink/submodule detection, state-root protection, report time and artifact-exchange display/tests; no relaxation of initial mock/loopback boundary.
host_install_pending_reasons: Owner and host-use coordination for concurrent k3s stop and libvirt installation are unanswered; policy allow condition 3 is unsatisfied.
Reviewer did not connect to sense. A fresh pre-install baseline for identity, paths, unit, port, workloads and recovery route is required after concurrent work.
Existing tunnel/proxy/Ingress, global IPv6, firewall and router reachability are unproven; AC-19 and private-ready remain pending.
execution_requirements: After host coordination and fresh baseline, obtain a separate independent host_install allow decision.
Copy the installer to a root-managed location, verify that copy against the fixed install_script hash, then run only that copy.
Do not reuse the decision if source, artifact, policy, environment, operation or expiry changes.
After install, measure loopback/LAN/public refusal, event continuity and stop/recovery.

limitations.authorization_boundary: code_candidate allow covers the fixed mock bootstrap code only; it does not authorize transfer, installation, real-model execution, notification sending, GitHub operations or public exposure.
